fallbacks.title: Platform defaults for uncovered controls
fallbacks.statement: If the system defines no control for a need, use the platform's native element with the system's rounded field styling and warm colours; keep native semantics.
constraints: mark the improvisation and report a gap if the need recurs

fallbacks.title: Plain content region
fallbacks.statement: Content without a defined composition sits in the shell as plain regions separated by generous spacing — softly, never in boxes.
constraints: spacing and soft tints, not hard rules
